sentences.text:
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.2262 Of 2019
Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and Mr.K.Ravinder Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for respondent No.4-GHMC.

2. The petitioners have approached this Court, seeking the following relief:
"to pass order or orders one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the action of the respondents for not payment of the compensation to the petitioners in pursuance of the acquisition of the land of the petitioners in Sy. No.87 to the extent of 4,434.13 Sq. yards equivalent to Ac.1.04 gnts. situated at Lalaguda (V) of Marredpally Mandal, Secunderabad in pursuance of the acquisition made on 27.09.1995 by G.O.No.408-A under the A.P. Slum Improvement Act, 1956 by the respondents herein and consequently direct the respondents to dispose of the representation "A to pay the Compensation of the acquisition of the land under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act 30 of 2013) in pursuance of the representation made by the petitioner to the respondent on 05.02.2015.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act 30 of 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: (B) Declare the said action of the respondents are totally illegal, arbitrary against the principles of natural justice, ultra virus against law and violation of 300-A of the Constitution of India."

3. It is the specific case of the petitioners that in spite of representation dated 05.02.2015 of the petitioners addressed to the Collector, Hyderabad District, Hyderabad, Telangana State, which has been acknowledged by the office of the 3rd respondent dated 05.02.2015, which pertains to the petitioners request for payment of compensation in respect of the petitioners ancestral property in Sy.No.87, to an extent of 4,434.13 square yards, situated in Lalaguda village of Marredpally Mandal,
acquired under the A.P.Slum Improvement (Acquisition of Land) in spite of several requests by the petitioners, no compensation has been paid to the petitioners till as on date and the petitioners had not been in a position to utilize their land since 1956.
4.

Mr.K.Ravinder Reddy, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of respondent No.4 submits that the present writ petition can be disposed of directing respondent Nos.3 and 4 to follow the due process of law.

sentences.text:
Bringing the said submission on record, the writ petition is disposed of directing respondent Nos.3 and 4 herein to consider the representation of the petitioners dated 05.02.2015 for release of compensation in respect of land of petitioners' in Survey No.87 to an extent of 4434.13 square yards equivalent to Ac.1.04 gts situated at Lalaguda (V) of Marredpally Mandal, Secunderabad in pursuance of the acquisition made on 27.09.1995 by G.O.Ms.No.408-A under the A.P. Slum Improvement Act, 1956 by the respondents, in accordance to law, and pass appropriate orders,
within a period of eight (08) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and duly communicating the decision to the petitioners.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
